name: Brigade Altius
description: Three 43-storey towers on OMR at Sholinganallur, about 143 m tall and linked by a skybridge, with 662 homes on 6.5 acres. Homes have no shared walls, and a 50,000 sq.ft clubhouse sits at podium level.
curation: Towers joined by a skybridge at height
Beside the upcoming Sholinganallur Metro station on OMR
connectivity: Next to the upcoming Sholinganallur Metro station
On OMR, with links to ECR
Close to SIPCOT IT Park and ELCOT SEZ
developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
